From a velocity-vs-time figure for a jet car: (a) find the displacement over the time shown, (b) calculate the acceleration as the slope of the velocity graph, (c) give the instantaneous velocity at t = 5 s, and (d) calculate the average velocity over the interval. The solution decomposes the area under the line into a rectangle (0 to 20 m/s over 30 s, 600 m) and a triangle (base 30 s, height 140 m/s, 2,100 m) for a net displacement of 2,700 m; takes points (5 s, 40 m/s) and (25 s, 140 m/s) for the slope; reads 40 m/s off the graph at 5 s; and divides 2,700 m / 30 s = 90 m/s.
